entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-08-29
entry.content:
Issues

  • Jitdump contains only 2 stub records and no methods on .NET 10 (Linux x64) — writer silently disabled after truncated stub-block record; regression from .NET 9 #132935
  • [API Proposal]: Add additional capacity overloads to `ToBuilder` for immutable collections. #132929
